name: daily-gpsr-compliance-check
description: Daily GPSR compliance check on all non-food product listings.
prompt: Query all active non-food product listings. Verify each has all 5 required GPSR fields: manufacturer_name, manufacturer_address, manufacturer_contact, risk_assessment_status, safety_notice_status. Suspend any non-food listing missing GPSR data. Generate daily GPSR compliance report.
